reviewDescription: I wasn’t sure what to expect, but these lavender shower steamers completely surprised me. The scent is calming without being overpowering — it fills the shower with a soft, relaxing lavender aroma that instantly makes it feel like a mini spa moment.They fizz slowly and last through most of my shower, especially if you place them out of the direct water stream. I love using one at night to wind down — it genuinely helps me relax after a long day.If you’re someone who doesn’t always have time for a bath but still wants that aromatherapy experience, these are perfect. Such an easy way to upgrade your shower routine!Will definitely repurchase. 💜🚿

reviewTitle: A little strong but well made!
reviewDescription: I love lavender scented things but this one was a bit strong for me (great though if you are not smell sensitive!)! The packaging was beautiful and makes it very easy to gift — I also appreciate the ease in being able to cut it in half (it is scored) as most steamers are only one size!
